% Checks a case the use of a .bbl beside the document must not break:
% biblatex with biber, the .bib that \addbibresource names, and a stale
% .bbl beside. biber runs, and the stale .bbl is not read.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage[backend=biber]{biblatex}
\addbibresource{test-biblatex-authoryear.bib}
\begin{document}
A citation~\cite{book}.
\printbibliography
\end{document}
